<div class="single-holder">
	<div class="article">
		<h1 class="headline">3 Mile Camp</h1>
<div style="height:20px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>
<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img data-recalc-dims="1" fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="800" height="191" data-attachment-id="2076" data-permalink="https://gnaraloostation.com/camp/" data-orig-file="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/camp.png?fit=800%2C191&amp;ssl=1" data-orig-size="800,191" data-comments-opened="1" data-image-title="Camp" data-image-description="" data-image-caption="" data-large-file="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/camp.png?fit=800%2C191&amp;ssl=1" src="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/camp.png?resize=800%2C191&#038;ssl=1" alt="" class="wp-image-2076" /></figure>
<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Bordering the beach at 3Mile Camp are 65 unpowered campsites.</strong><br><strong>3 Mile Camp offers 4 styles of camping: Basic sites, Primo sites, the Lagoon site and the Hilton. See details below.</strong></p>
<p class="has-text-align-center wp-block-paragraph">The back-to-basics style sites are complemented by a <a href="https://gnaraloostation.com/3-mile-lagoon/" style="color:orange">protected lagoon</a><strong>&nbsp;</strong>that’s perfect for snorkelling, and  <a href="https://gnaraloostation.com/tombstone-tombies/" style="color:orange">Tombstones</a> surf break that boasts one of the best waves in the world. You will also find several spots to access great fishing.</p>
<div style="height:20px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>

<div style="height:20px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>
<div class="wp-block-columns has-background is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-8f761849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex" style="background-color:#f8f8f8">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>• WATER</strong><br>Facilities to accompany your camping at 3 Mile Camp are 3 ablution blocks using artisan water for flushing toilets, hot showers and kitchen sinks for your dishes and laundry.<br><br><strong>• GENERATORS</strong><br>Silenced generators are tolerated (conditions apply) when used with respect to other campers.<br><br><strong>• DOGS</strong><br>Well behaved dogs are permitted onsite (fees and conditions apply).</p>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>• SHOP</strong><br>We also have a small well-stocked shop on site which sells most basic grocery items, drinking water and a few luxury items too like cold beer, wireless internet, and power to recharge items or plug a fridge in.<br><br><strong>• TIPS</strong><br>For more information on recommended items to pack, read through our <a href="https://gnaraloostation.com/know-before-you-go/" style="color:orange">Know before you go</a> section. We recommend that you prepare well for your visit here &#8211; the more self sufficient you are, the more comfortable your stay will be.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center" id="basic-sites">Basic Sites</h2>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Basic sites are of average size some offer&nbsp; a rock fireplace for cooking or evening comfort, and wind shelters, all with great views.</p>
<div class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow aligncenter" data-effect="slide"><div class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_container swiper-container"><ul class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_swiper-wrapper swiper-wrapper"><li class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_slide swiper-slide"><figure><img data-recalc-dims="1" decoding="async" width="800" height="533" alt="3 Mile Camp - Basic Sites" class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_image wp-image-2106" data-id="2106" src="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/accommodation-3milecamp-basicsites-tree.jpg?resize=800%2C533&#038;ssl=1" /></figure></li><li class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_slide swiper-slide"><figure><img data-recalc-dims="1" decoding="async" width="800" height="533" alt="3 Mile Camp - Basic Sites" class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_image wp-image-2103" data-id="2103" src="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/accommodation-3milecamp-basicsites-camping.jpg?resize=800%2C533&#038;ssl=1" /></figure></li><li class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_slide swiper-slide"><figure><img data-recalc-dims="1" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="800" height="533" alt="3 Mile Camp - Basic Sites" class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_image wp-image-2105" data-id="2105" src="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/accommodation-3milecamp-basicsites-camps.jpg?resize=800%2C533&#038;ssl=1" /></figure></li></ul><a class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_button-prev swiper-button-prev swiper-button-white" role="button"></a><a class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_button-next swiper-button-next swiper-button-white" role="button"></a><a aria-label="Pause Slideshow" class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_button-pause" role="button"></a><div class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_pagination swiper-pagination swiper-pagination-white"></div></div></div>

<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center" id="primo-sites">Primo Sites</h2>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Primo sites are the more popular sites, some having a fireplace,&nbsp; most have either an ocean front, larger or offer a tree for shade.</p>
<div class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow aligncenter" data-effect="slide"><div class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_container swiper-container"><ul class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_swiper-wrapper swiper-wrapper"><li class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_slide swiper-slide"><figure><img data-recalc-dims="1" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="800" height="533" alt="3 Mile Camp - Primo Site" class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_image wp-image-2107" data-id="2107" src="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/accommodation-3milecamp-primosites-oceanfront.jpg?resize=800%2C533&#038;ssl=1" /></figure></li><li class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_slide swiper-slide"><figure><img data-recalc-dims="1" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="800" height="533" alt="3 Mile Camp - <div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-8f761849 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center" id="the-lagoon">The Lagoon</h2>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Lagoon site is one of the most sought after sites.<br>It is a large private site located adjacent to the lagoon, slightly separated from the rest of the camp, offering a lot of space for large groups and protected from most winds.</p>
<div class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow aligncenter" data-effect="slide"><div class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_container swiper-container"><ul class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_swiper-wrapper swiper-wrapper"><li class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_slide swiper-slide"><figure><img data-recalc-dims="1" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="800" height="533" alt="3 Mile Camp - Lagoon Site" class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_image wp-image-2124" data-id="2124" src="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/accommodation-3milecamp-lagoonsite.jpg?resize=800%2C533&#038;ssl=1" /></figure></li><li class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_slide swiper-slide"><figure><img data-recalc-dims="1" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="800" height="533" alt="3 Mile Camp - Lagoon Site" class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_image wp-image-2123" data-id="2123" src="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/accommodation-3milecamp-lagoonsite-setup.jpg?resize=800%2C533&#038;ssl=1" /></figure></li><li class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_slide swiper-slide"><figure><img data-recalc-dims="1" loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="800" height="533" alt="3 Mile Camp - Lagoon Site" class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_image wp-image-2129" data-id="2129" src="https://i0.wp.com/gnaraloostation.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/accommodation-3milecamp-lagoonsite-lagoon.jpg?resize=800%2C533&#038;ssl=1" /></figure></li></ul><a class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_button-prev swiper-button-prev swiper-button-white" role="button"></a><a class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_button-next swiper-button-next swiper-button-white" role="button"></a><a aria-label="Pause Slideshow" class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_button-pause" role="button"></a><div class="wp-block-jetpack-slideshow_pagination swiper-pagination swiper-pagination-white"></div></div></div>

<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center" id="the-hilton">The Hilton</h2>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Hilton is the only beach shack along the ocean front available at 3Mile Camp, it is a basic shelter with simple shelving and a table inside, great for your kitchen setup or as a communal area. Plenty of parking around the shack for tents or vans.</p>
